caption: 「這個檔案根本不存在。它是壞的。」
scene: A dim futuristic lab conference room, a pompous older man in a three-piece suit slams a report onto the table, a man in his 40s with messy curly hair, round glasses and a navy blue hoodie with a small ladybug pin sits in a wheelchair, low angle, harsh cold lighting, tension in the air

caption: 「程博士，您知道我們一年預算多少嗎？」
scene: The pompous older man leans forward with a condescending smirk, young engineers in the background stifling laughter, one engineer's phone slipping from his hand mid-air, the seated man with round glasses stays calm, cool blue fluorescent light

caption: 「您解不開，是因為鎖太小。」
scene: Close-up of the man in the navy hoodie pushing his round glasses up his nose, wheelchair wheel visible, the room frozen, the pompous man's face shifting from red to pale, dramatic side light, dust motes in the air

caption: 「我捐的。」
scene: Wide shot of the silent conference room, the pompous older man's jaw dropped, a phone shattering on the floor, engineers frozen mid-gesture, the man in the hoodie turning his wheelchair toward the door, single spotlight on him, deep shadows

caption: 「那裡面不是資料。是一個人。」
scene: The man in the wheelchair glides down a long futuristic corridor, rain-streaked windows on one side, a small translucent glowing cyan blonde hologram girl in an oversized white hoodie floating beside his shoulder, soft cyan glow reflecting on the floor

caption: 「我現在這個樣子，AI 做不出來。皺紋太醜。」
scene: A cozy night-market noodle stall under warm yellow lanterns, the man in the navy hoodie points at his own wrinkled face, a crying young woman lowers her phone, a young man in an apron behind the stove bursts out laughing, steam rising, warm golden light

caption: 「哥，我最大的遺憾，是吃不到滷肉飯。」
scene: An old desk by a rainy window at night, the man in the navy hoodie holds up a worn round pair of glasses, a faint translucent cyan blonde hologram girl flickers into view, teary eyes, a small ladybug pin glinting, soft blue moonlight, dust in the air

caption: 「我們來 debug 一下。」
scene: The man in the navy hoodie stands at a window overlooking a rainy futuristic Taipei skyline at dawn, rain stopping, a translucent glowing cyan hologram girl beside him smiling, city lights reflecting in puddles, hopeful warm light breaking through clouds
